mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diag_precompute_job ( tenant_id, job_code, module_code, status_code, priority, request_json, request_hash, read_range_type, read_start, read_end, window_types, force_rebuild, max_retry, retry_count, progress_percent, current_stage, total_windows, done_windows, rows_read, rows_written, submitted_by, submitted_time ) VALUES ( #{row.tenantId}, #{row.jobCode}, #{row.moduleCode}, #{row.statusCode}, #{row.priority}, #{row.requestJson}, #{row.requestHash}, #{row.readRangeType}, #{row.readStart}, #{row.readEnd}, #{row.windowTypes}, #{row.forceRebuild}, #{row.maxRetry}, #{row.retryCount}, #{row.progressPercent}, #{row.currentStage}, #{row.totalWindows}, #{row.doneWindows}, #{row.rowsRead}, #{row.rowsWritten}, #{row.submittedBy}, ISNULL(#{row.submittedTime}, SYSUTCDATETIME()) )
mapper.update: UPDATE diag_precompute_job SET progress_percent = #{row.progressPercent}, current_stage = #{row.currentStage}, total_windows = #{row.totalWindows}, done_windows = #{row.doneWindows}, rows_read = #{row.rowsRead}, rows_written = #{row.rowsWritten}, update_time = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE tenant_id = #{row.tenantId} AND job_id = #{row.jobId}

UPDATE diag_precompute_job SET status_code = #{row.statusCode}, current_stage = #{row.currentStage}, retry_count = COALESCE(#{row.retryCount}, retry_count), started_time = COALESCE(#{row.startedTime}, started_time), finished_time = COALESCE(#{row.finishedTime}, finished_time), error_message = #{row.errorMessage}, update_time = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE tenant_id = #{row.tenantId} AND job_id = #{row.jobId}
mapper.select: SELECT job_id AS jobId, tenant_id AS tenantId, job_code AS jobCode, module_code AS moduleCode, status_code AS statusCode, priority, request_json AS requestJson, request_hash AS requestHash, read_range_type AS readRangeType, read_start AS readStart, read_end AS readEnd, window_types AS windowTypes, force_rebuild AS forceRebuild, max_retry AS maxRetry, retry_count AS retryCount, progress_percent AS progressPercent, current_stage AS currentStage, total_windows AS totalWindows, done_windows AS doneWindows, rows_read AS rowsRead, rows_written AS rowsWritten, submitted_by AS submittedBy, submitted_time AS submittedTime, started_time AS startedTime, finished_time AS finishedTime, error_message AS errorMessage, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM diag_precompute_job WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND job_id = #{jobId}

SELECT job_id AS jobId, tenant_id AS tenantId, job_code AS jobCode, module_code AS moduleCode, status_code AS statusCode, priority, request_json AS requestJson, request_hash AS requestHash, read_range_type AS readRangeType, read_start AS readStart, read_end AS readEnd, window_types AS windowTypes, force_rebuild AS forceRebuild, max_retry AS maxRetry, retry_count AS retryCount, progress_percent AS progressPercent, current_stage AS currentStage, total_windows AS totalWindows, done_windows AS doneWindows, rows_read AS rowsRead, rows_written AS rowsWritten, submitted_by AS submittedBy, submitted_time AS submittedTime, started_time AS startedTime, finished_time AS finishedTime, error_message AS errorMessage, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM diag_precompute_job WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND job_code = #{jobCode}

SELECT TOP 1 job_id AS jobId, tenant_id AS tenantId, job_code AS jobCode, module_code AS moduleCode, status_code AS statusCode, priority, request_json AS requestJson, request_hash AS requestHash, read_range_type AS readRangeType, read_start AS readStart, read_end AS readEnd, window_types AS windowTypes, force_rebuild AS forceRebuild, max_retry AS maxRetry, retry_count AS retryCount, progress_percent AS progressPercent, current_stage AS currentStage, total_windows AS totalWindows, done_windows AS doneWindows, rows_read AS rowsRead, rows_written AS rowsWritten, submitted_by AS submittedBy, submitted_time AS submittedTime, started_time AS startedTime, finished_time AS finishedTime, error_message AS errorMessage, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM diag_precompute_job WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND request_hash = #{requestHash} AND status_code IN ('PENDING', 'RUNNING', 'RETRYING') ORDER BY submitted_time DESC, job_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diag_precompute_window ( tenant_id, job_id, window_key, window_type, period_start, period_end, compare_start, compare_end, status_code, progress_percent, current_stage, data_version, retry_count, rows_read, rows_written, started_time, finished_time, error_message ) VALUES ( #{row.tenantId}, #{row.jobId}, #{row.windowKey}, #{row.windowType}, #{row.periodStart}, #{row.periodEnd}, #{row.compareStart}, #{row.compareEnd}, #{row.statusCode}, #{row.progressPercent}, #{row.currentStage}, #{row.dataVersion}, #{row.retryCount}, #{row.rowsRead}, #{row.rowsWritten}, #{row.startedTime}, #{row.finishedTime}, #{row.errorMessage} )
mapper.update: UPDATE diag_precompute_window SET status_code = #{row.statusCode}, progress_percent = #{row.progressPercent}, current_stage = #{row.currentStage}, data_version = #{row.dataVersion}, retry_count = COALESCE(#{row.retryCount}, retry_count), rows_read = #{row.rowsRead}, rows_written = #{row.rowsWritten}, started_time = COALESCE(#{row.startedTime}, started_time), finished_time = COALESCE(#{row.finishedTime}, finished_time), error_message = #{row.errorMessage}, update_time = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE tenant_id = #{row.tenantId} AND window_id = #{row.windowId}
mapper.select: SELECT window_id AS windowId, tenant_id AS tenantId, job_id AS jobId, window_key AS windowKey, window_type AS windowType, period_start AS periodStart, period_end AS periodEnd, compare_start AS compareStart, compare_end AS compareEnd, status_code AS statusCode, progress_percent AS progressPercent, current_stage AS currentStage, data_version AS dataVersion, retry_count AS retryCount, rows_read AS rowsRead, rows_written AS rowsWritten, started_time AS startedTime, finished_time AS finishedTime, error_message AS errorMessage, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM diag_precompute_window WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY window_id ASC

SELECT window_id AS windowId, tenant_id AS tenantId, job_id AS jobId, window_key AS windowKey, window_type AS windowType, period_start AS periodStart, period_end AS periodEnd, compare_start AS compareStart, compare_end AS compareEnd, status_code AS statusCode, progress_percent AS progressPercent, current_stage AS currentStage, data_version AS dataVersion, retry_count AS retryCount, rows_read AS rowsRead, rows_written AS rowsWritten, started_time AS startedTime, finished_time AS finishedTime, error_message AS errorMessage, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM diag_precompute_window WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND window_id = #{windowId}

SELECT TOP 1 window_id AS windowId, tenant_id AS tenantId, job_id AS jobId, window_key AS windowKey, window_type AS windowType, period_start AS periodStart, period_end AS periodEnd, compare_start AS compareStart, compare_end AS compareEnd, status_code AS statusCode, progress_percent AS progressPercent, current_stage AS currentStage, data_version AS dataVersion, retry_count AS retryCount, rows_read AS rowsRead, rows_written AS rowsWritten, started_time AS startedTime, finished_time AS finishedTime, error_message AS errorMessage, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM diag_precompute_window WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND job_id = #{jobId} AND status_code = 'PENDING' ORDER BY window_id ASC

SELECT t.event_id AS eventId, t.tenant_id AS tenantId, t.job_id AS jobId, t.window_id AS windowId, t.event_time AS eventTime, t.event_level AS eventLevel, t.event_stage AS eventStage, t.event_message AS eventMessage, t.payload_json AS payloadJson, t.create_time AS createTime FROM ( SELECT event_id, tenant_id, job_id, window_id, event_time, event_level, event_stage, event_message, payload_json, create_time, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY event_id DESC) AS rn FROM diag_precompute_event WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND job_id = #{jobId} ) t WHERE t.rn <= COALESCE(#{limit}, 200) ORDER BY t.event_id DESC
